content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT BHU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 27-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT BHU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IIT BHU Project Associate I / Project Assistant posts is 27 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate I / Project Assistant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Project Associate I and Project Assistant positions at IIT BHU.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Project Associate I?
faq.answer: For Project Associate I, candidates need a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Engineering/Professional Course, selected through GATE/CSIR-UGC NET or IIT (BHU) national level examinations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 27,000 to Rs. 37,000 per month, with additional House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per the specific post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IIT BHU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for these posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply by sending their resume and required documents via email before the last date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions are contractual in nature.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT BHU located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology (Banaras Hindu University) is located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 221005.
